data.long_meaning: From the Greek word reganō, meaning 'to be born again'. In Christian tradition, this name symbolizes spiritual renewal and rebirth. The name Rena carries the meaning “Reborn” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Rena usually hope their child will grow to embody reborn and live with faith, good character and purpose.
